blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Twenty-nine families, comprising 107 individuals, evacuated in Agoncillo, Batangas, after a minor phreatomagmatic eruption of Taal Volcano on Thursday evening. Citing the latest data from the evacuation center information board, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) reported Friday morning that the households, made up of 54 males and 53 females, have taken shelter at the socio-civic center in Barangay Pansipit The evacuees left their homes in Barangays Bilibinwang and Banyaga, which were most affected by the volcanic ashfall. Social workers are attending to their needs at the evacuation center. READ: Ashfall from Taal Volcano’s minor eruption to affect nearby […]...
